data.name: Daryush
data.gender_notes: Daryush is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian language, Daryush means 'ruler' or 'king'. This powerful name is deeply rooted in Persian and Islamic culture, symbolizing strength, wisdom, and leadership. The name Daryush carries the meaning “King, Ruler” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Daryush usually hope their child will grow to embody king, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Signifies divine guidance and righteous rule in accordance with Islamic principles.
data.etymology: Daryush belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “King, Ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Daryush total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

historical_references.reference: Darius III, the last king of the Achaemenid Empire of Persia before its conquest by Alexander the Great in 330 BC.
historical_references.context: Darius III was known as 'Darayavaush' or 'Daryush' in the Persian language, meaning 'ruler of the good opinion'.

historical_references.reference: Darya-i-Pur, an ancient site in modern-day Afghanistan, was the capital city of the Indo-Bactrian Kingdom during the Hellenistic period, around the 2nd century BC. The city was named after Daryush, a local ruler.
historical_references.context: The name 'Daryush' or 'Darius' was commonly used among the Indo-Bactrian and Indo-Greek rulers, derived from the Persian king Darius the Great.

Lastly, the globalization of names has led to Daryush being adopted by individuals outside of the Middle East and Iran, making it a trend on professional networking sites like LinkedIn.
